universeDeck.title: A cinematic navigation deck for exploring planets and galaxies.
universeDeck.subtitle: This is a productized "mission control" layer inspired by scientific exploration interfaces, adapted to Gravity-Souls data instead of copying NASA's UI. The center canvas is the spatial story. The panels are operational context.
universeDeck.emptyOrbit: Your orbit is empty. Start with Resonance.
universeDeck.flightFollow: Follow orbit nodes to jump between related entities.
universeDeck.flightTelemetry: Use the right panel as telemetry instead of opening a new page every time.
universeDeck.planetSubtitle: Inspect one identity core at a time, then pivot into the galaxies and neighboring signatures around it.
universeDeck.galaxySubtitle: Move between cultural clusters, inspect active members, and follow how each galaxy links to the next.
universeDeck.whyWorksBody: The viewport does the emotional heavy lifting first. Lists and metrics become support layers, which is the right hierarchy for a world-exploration product.
universeDeck.interactionModelBody: Focus one object, inspect nearby signals, then jump sideways. That keeps navigation spatial instead of turning everything into repeated cards and pages.
universeDeck.productionPathBody: This can become a real product surface by adding zoom states, camera transitions, live filtering, and route-synced focus so the deck is deep-linkable.
universeDeck.routeLinksBody: Use this demo as the reference layer before deciding whether the command deck should replace the current home universe view.
